name: Haemal Vambrace
description: Open with a lead jab cupped like a basin's lip so the next blow has a place to land.

name: Statute Cuffplate
description: Raise both cuffs together as the rim of a basin to hold off a blow to the head.

name: Ethereal Thumbplate
description: Step so that both feet and both gloves arrive together on the new line.

name: Steel Elbowcop
description: Pass the fist's momentum from the lead glove to the rear glove so the blow arrives from a new angle.

name: Thrallvamb
description: Hold a wrist between both steel palms and keep qi in the hold to resist a pull.

name: Squall Fingerplate
description: Pour a thrust off the cuff and down the arm like water off a tilted basin.

name: Bedrock Backhandplate
description: Raise both fists and drop them together like a basin tipped over a doorstep onto the guard.

name: Peremptory Palmguard
description: Clasp the opponent's forearm between both gauntlets and seal the qi in the arm.

name: Vacuum Wristcuff
description: Join both gauntlets at the wrist and drive the pair as one spearhead through armor and bone.

name: Paramount Wring
description: Move both gauntlets as one pair through the exchange so each guard is also an attack and each blow a cover.

name: Quenched Knucklecap
description: Send the lead gauntlet straight out as the first call of the attack court.

name: Prism Elbowcop
description: Hold the rear cuff upright like a rail so blows glance off before they reach the body.

name: Mittsolace
description: Slide along the edge of the opponent's reach so the guard court faces him squarely.

name: Thunderclap Clench
description: Let the attack court send a heavy hammer blow while the guard court holds the opponent's line.

name: Sigilvamb
description: Close both courts on one arm from either side and hold with steady qi.

name: Pall Fingerplate
description: Slip the guard cuff under a blow and carry it out and over the shoulder.

name: Interstice Backhandplate
description: Rest a steel palm on the opponent's arm and read where his weight is about to go.

name: Peerless Grasp
description: Drive the attack court's fingerplates into an armor seam so the pair of courts split it between them.

name: Statute Palmguard
description: Press both gauntlets on the opponent's guard and hold it down by sustained field pressure.

name: Prismmitt
description: Take a qi blow on the guard court and burst the same force back through the attack court.

name: Seasonclench
description: Chain the two courts through attack guard hold and strike in one rehearsed sequence the school teaches by rote.

name: Vigor Grasp
description: Jab along a curving line so the plated fist arrives from the outside of the guard.

name: Enshrined Gauntcuff
description: Hold the cuff in the hollow of the bend and let a blow slide around it.

name: Vigor Wristcuff
description: Slide close along the opponent's flank with the glove tucked against the ribs.

name: Clampdecree
description: Flick a short hard backhand onto the cheekbone like a pebble thrown at the face.

name: Steel Wring
description: Turn the hips through the bend of the stance and drop the hammer fist at its end.

name: Thrall Seizeup
description: Wind the cuff along the arm in a slow meander and press the elbow to the ribs.

name: Delugeglove
description: Spiral the cuff round a spear shaft and lead its point out of line.

name: Gloveverdict
description: Drive the steel palm into the hip so the opponent trips over the foot behind him.

name: Haemal Clench
description: Gather force through a deep bend in the stance and release it in one crushing fist.

name: Crushing Clamp
description: Lock the steel fingers on a limb and keep churning it against the joint like rapids over stone.

name: Pulsarwring
description: Vanish round the bend of a blow and return to strike from the side before it has passed.

name: Lordly Clamp
description: Carry a blow around the bend of the stance into a hold so force is turned and never stopped.

name: Steel Vambrace
description: Throw the lead fist like a hawk's first pass over the opponent's guard.

name: Statute Gauntcuff
description: Spread the cuffed forearms like folded wings across the face and chest.

name: Surging Knucklecap
description: Circle the opponent at the edge of reach and keep both gloves toward him.

name: Glovebenison
description: Rest the steel palm on a held limb and read the opponent's next move by its tremor.

name: Noble Cuffplate
description: Dive the fist from above and behind the guard to strike the face over the top.

name: Millstone Thumbplate
description: Hook the steel fingers over a limb like talons and keep qi in the grip.

name: Quenched Clench
description: Stoop from the court's high line with the fingerplates leading and punch through plate.

name: Sigilclench
description: Clamp wrist and elbow in the steel palm and seal the arm's qi like a court sealing a ruling.

name: Animaglove
description: Pronounce the stoop with a held breath and let the fist drop through all armor into the body.

name: Gallant Cuffplate Crown
description: Stoop with the fist then hold the same arm in the court's grip so the judgment lands and stays.

name: Fearless Elbowcop
description: Open on the first track with a straight fist while the second glove covers the field.

name: Unyielding Thumbplate
description: Lay the second cuff along the second track to catch what the first fist has exposed.

name: Soundless Palmguard
description: Step off one track and onto the other without breaking the line of the fists.

name: Enshrined Wristcuff
description: Sweep the guarding palm in a slow circle that thickens the qi field in front of it.

name: Quenched Backhandplate
description: Strike with the second fist from inside the guarding field where no blow can reach it.

name: Subjugating Clamp
description: Catch both of the opponent's wrists at once between the two steel hands.

name: Deluge Gauntcuff
description: Cross the two forearms in a tight X so a blow slides off and out along either track.

name: Pulsarglove
description: Drive one gauntlet through a guard behind the field cover of the other gauntlet.

name: Gloomwring
description: Hold both of the opponent's arms down under the qi field of the twin gauntlets.

name: Thunderclap Grasp
description: Switch tracks in a flash of field qi and land the fist where the opponent was not guarding.

name: Consecrated Fingerplate
description: Hold the field with one gauntlet and strike within it with the other and keep to the pattern through every exchange.

name: Intrepid Seizeup
description: Send the lead jab from the center of the body along the first track of the core.

name: Stalwart Knucklecap
description: Hold the cuff against the chest and let the core steady the whole arm.

name: Skyborne Seizeup
description: Glide with the weight centered over the core so both gloves stay level.

name: Thunderclap Vambrace
description: Send a pulse from the core straight down the lead arm into the plated fist.

name: Mittpledge
description: Catch an arm on the second track and feed the hold from the core.

name: Pealvamb
description: Turn the core and the cuff together to send a blow past the shoulder.

name: Famed Crushgrip
description: Split the core's pulse into two and drive both fists through the same guard together.

name: Grasptroth
description: Anchor the arm to the core and press the opponent's guard down without tiring.

name: Harbinger Thumbplate
description: Draw the whole core into the fist and strike so the force passes through all defense into the body.

name: Crushgrip Triumph
description: Run the two tracks from the core in a rehearsed sequence of guard hold and strike that the school drills.

name: Inferno Clench
description: Jab with the fingers half open and close the fist only in the last inch.

name: Fingerplate Vow
description: Lift the cuff with the palm open to catch a thrown blade or a blow alike.

name: Surging Wristcuff
description: Step to the windward side so the opponent's arm swings against the wind.

name: Squall Elbowcop
description: Swing the sworn hand back across the face with the steel backplate leading.

name: Steelglove
description: Push the open steel palm into the breastbone on a surge of breath.

name: Pallvamb
description: Bend the guard arm with the force of a blow and then snap it round to turn the blow aside.

name: Clenchvow
description: Hook the steel fingers in a sleeve and tow the opponent off his line.

name: Wring Troth
description: Sweep the outstretched arm across the opponent's reach to knock a weapon hand wide.

name: Cuffplate Decree
description: Cut through a guard with the fingerplates the way the wind parts tall grass.

name: Despotic Gauntcuff
description: Lay the open palm on the opponent's arm and seal its qi until the wind passes.

name: Parity Palmguard
description: Stop a qi blow dead with the open steel palm sworn to the wind.

name: Thunderclap Wring
description: Meet each blow with an open palm that turns it and close the fist on the turn to strike back.

name: Haemal Seizeup
description: Jab down the sworn line and hold the arm out until the line is cleared.

name: Undefiled Knucklecap
description: Plant the cuff like a rock on the plateau so the blow breaks on it.

name: Bedrock Vambrace
description: Advance in short steps without leaving the sworn line.

name: Bedrock Crushgrip
description: Bring the heavy fist down on the line the opponent must cross.

name: Sigil Clamp
description: Pin the opponent's arm along the line and keep qi in the pin.

name: Squall Wristcuff
description: Slap a thrust off the line with the flat of the cuff and keep the footing.

name: Vambtriumph
description: Drive the fist along the sworn line and break through whatever stands upon it.

name: Millstone Clamp
description: Lean the weight of the glove onto the opponent's arm and keep it there.

name: Wringedict
description: Swear the line aloud and drive the fist along it with all the field behind it.

name: Undaunted Backhandplate
description: Hold the sworn line with a guard that never gives ground and answer every approach with a fist.

name: Steel Crushgrip
description: Take the bearing of the opponent's chest and jab the gale glove along it.

name: Prismvamb
description: Brace the cuff on the bearing of the blow so it cannot force the arm off line.

name: Vigor Backhandplate
description: Pivot the body about the lead foot without letting the glove's bearing drift.

name: Illustrious Knucklecap
description: Judge the range by bearing and drop the hammer fist exactly at its end.

name: Squall Vambrace
description: Correct the heading of the cuff in the instant of contact to divert a swing.

name: Millstone Crushgrip
description: Take hold of an arm along the bearing and keep the grip from sliding off.

name: Revelation Elbowcop
description: Rest the palm on a guarded arm to read the bearing along which the arm will strike.

name: Matchless Grasp
description: Drive the fingerplates through armor along a bearing the glove has already read.

name: Volition Wring
description: Press the opponent's guard down along the bearing while qi is renewed each breath.

name: Seasonclamp
description: Flash along the held bearing and land the gale glove from an angle that was not guarded.

name: Destiny Gauntcuff
description: Take the bearing hold it and strike along it in the fixed sequence the school drills for the gale glove.

name: Fingerplate Banner
description: Jab the steel hand from a stance that offers no cover behind it.

name: Sacrosanct Cuffplate
description: Hold the forearm up as a screen with open ground on all sides.

name: Clenchodyssey
description: Take a pace forward each time the opponent pushes so that no ground is lost.

name: Heroic Palmguard
description: Drop the steel hand from above like a hammer on a raised guard.

name: Parity Thumbplate
description: Slash the cuff across a thrust like a gust cutting across a field.

name: Thrallwring
description: Clamp the opponent's hand in the steel fingers and keep qi in the clamp.

name: Radiance Grasp
description: Drive the fingerplates into plate with nothing behind the strike but the body's own weight.

name: Gloom Clench
description: Hold the open steel palm over the opponent's arm and press it down by steady qi.

name: Vacuum Wring
description: Gather the wind and the body's whole weight into one fist and strike through armor to the flesh.

name: Magnificent Haemal Gauntcuff
description: Stand in the open and answer every blow from any side with the same steel hand.

name: Glovecrown
description: Throw the lead fist at the apex of the stride with the wind behind it.

name: Adamant Backhandplate
description: Raise the cuff high against the gust of an overhead blow.

name: Bedrock Grasp
description: Take the long stride of the school and carry both fists level through it.

name: Graspverdict
description: Ride the qi field outward and hook the fist round the guard with the wind.

name: Prismglove
description: Feed the cuff with qi so it shelters the whole forearm against a heavy press.

name: Thrall Vambrace
description: Catch a wrist in the steel hand with the surge of an arriving gust.

name: Knucklecap Benison
description: Hold the palm still and read the wind of the opponent's movement through the field.

name: Splendid Clench
description: Burst through plate with a thrust fed by the whole field and the oath of the stance.

name: Retribution Palmguard
description: Seal the opponent's arm with the steel palm as the wind seals a still pond.

name: Season Fingerplate
description: Ride the field in one flash across the gap and land the fist before the gust has passed.

name: Hospitable Volition Cuffplate
description: Let the oath fill the field around the arm and strike with all of it at the top of the stride.

name: Inferno Thumbplate
description: Swing the heavy glove from the core and let its weight finish the blow.

name: Prism Wristcuff
description: Settle the weight into the core and take a heavy hit square on the cuff.

name: Soundless Seizeup
description: Lean the core into each step so the heavy glove never drags the body.

name: Crushgrip Banner
description: Hurl the heavy backplate round from the core and strike the temple.

name: Squall Crushgrip
description: Drive the core's pressure down the arm and drop the glove like a falling anvil.

name: Vambseal
description: Meet a swing with the heavy cuff and lead it away at the slow pace of its own weight.

name: Clampseal
description: Clamp the heavy glove on an arm and let its weight and a steady flow of qi do the holding.

name: Vigor Clamp
description: Shove with the heavy palm along a held bearing and send the opponent back.

name: Thunderclap Elbowcop
description: Drop the heavy glove with the core's whole pressure behind it onto a raised guard.

name: Peremptory Vambrace
description: Rest the heavy glove on the opponent's arm and keep the core's pressure on it.

name: Steelclamp
description: Gather the wind into the core and burst through plate and body with the heavy glove.

name: Illustrious Cuffplate Triumph
description: Swing the heavy glove from the core in one long breath that guards at its start and ends in a crushing blow.
